name: UGC 8061 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 8061, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc08061-hubble
story: A dwarf irregular galaxy whose red giant stars were too faint for Hubble to pick out, a sign that it lies far beyond where it was expected. It apparently belongs to the crowded core of the Virgo Cluster.

claims.text: UGC 8061 (UGC08061, EVCC1253) is a dwarf irregular galaxy
The CMD of UGC 8061 shows no red giant branch above I = 26.5 mag, giving only a lower distance limit
UGC 8061 apparently belongs to the virial core of the Virgo Cluster
